cmd: echo ---PS; ps -eo pid,etimes,time,rss,args --sort=-time | grep -v -E 'ps -eo|grep|kworker|ksoftirq|migration|rcu_|\[' | head -32 | cut -c1-150; echo ---TIMERS; systemctl list-timers --no-pager --plain | head -14 | cut -c1-150; echo ---CRON; for u in root ubuntu tbot; do echo user=$u; crontab -u $u -l 2>&1 | grep -v '^#' | head -12; done; ls /etc/cron.d | head; echo ---LISTEN; ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1{print $4, $6}' | sort | head -30 2>&1 | LC_ALL=C tr -cd '\11\12\40-\176'
